theory.title: Make, let and allow with object + infinitive
theory.explanation: Use make + object + bare infinitive when someone forces or causes an action; let + object + bare infinitive for permission; allow + object + to-infinitive. In the passive, make is followed by to + infinitive: We were made to wait.
theory.tip: Make / let + persona + infinitivo sin to. Allow + persona + to + infinitivo.

items.prompt: Describe a rule that lets students use technology.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy different kinds of media because they help me learn about the world and relax. I usually choose programmes that are informative and well presented. I also like discussing films and documentaries with friends because we often have different opinions. Although some online stories are not reliable, I try to check the source before sharing them. In the future, I think media will become more personalised, but good journalism will remain important.

A: I read a positive review online. B: Was it from a reliable source? A: Yes, although there was one advertisement during the break. B: I watched it on a streaming service. A: What's your opinion of the series? B: It's a very interesting programme.
